findings.summary: machinecheck continues to run package help/status/doctor whenever bin/pa exists, even after preflight reports REFUSED. A wrong expected build produces REFUSED then all3 package command attempts in a pure control.
findings.next: Return the preflight refusal before any package CLI or optional support execution. Require fully verified immutable subject/closure before crossing into the package command boundary. Add complete positive plus wrong subject/hash/file/manifest negatives asserting send/exec count0.

findings.summary: readTokenFile uses statSync, which follows a symlink; info.isSymbolicLink then cannot enforce the stated no-symlink rule. An explicit symlink to a fresh private canary token is accepted.
findings.next: Open the exact regular private file without following links, verify descriptor identity/ownership/mode and bounded contents; test symlink/FIFO/replacement/permission cases. No actual secret disclosure is claimed by this audit.

findings.summary: satisfiesNode returns early once the current version exceeds a lower-bound component and never checks maxMajor. Actual24.21.0 is reported PASS against >=23.0.0 <24 in a complete tiny package.
findings.next: Validate both bounds with a structured version comparator or existing proven semver API; unsupported grammar stays unknown. Add lower/equal/upper/excluded-major controls without claiming new platform support.

findings.summary: verifyRun uses run.wallElapsedSeconds without comparing startedAt/endedAt or sample.at. Copying the genuine600s run and setting endedAt equal to startedAt still yields consistency.ok=true with a claimed600seconds.
findings.next: Derive wall duration and raw sample time spans independently, compare monotonic elapsed/cadence/counters and bounded source files, reject contradictions. This defect does not erase the genuine submitted600/1800s observations, whose actual dates and raw samples agree.
